talks.speaker: 蒋赉
talks.affiliation: 国科大杭州高等研究院
talks.title: Representations of rational numbers and Minkowski dimension
talks.location: 武大·雷军科技楼601报告厅
talks.abstract: In this talk, we investigate the representations of rational numbers via continued fractions, Egyptian fractions, and Engel fractions. For each integer $m$, let $C_m, E_m, E_m^*$ denote the sets of rationals whose continued fraction, Egyptian fraction, and Engel fraction expansions have length $m$, respectively. Let $H_m$ be the set of Gaussian rationals with Hurwitz continued fraction expansions of length $m$. We compute the Minkowski dimensions of these sets, showing that they exhibit distinct global scaling properties. We further determine their Minkowski contents and apply our results to sumsets of decreasing sequences.

talks.speaker: Yann Bugeaud
talks.title: Multiplicative rational p-adic approximation
talks.location: 武大·数学与统计学院A644报告厅
talks.abstract: Let p be a prime number and x an irrational p-adic number. The multiplicative irrationality exponent m(x) (resp. uniform multiplicative irrationality exponent u(x)) of x is the supremum of the real numbers m for which the inequalities 0 < |a b|^{1/2} < A and |b x - a|_p < A^{-m} have a solution in integers a, b for arbitrarily large real numbers A (resp., for every sufficiently large real number A). We show that these exponents of approximation can be expressed in terms of exponents of approximation attached to a sequence of rational numbers defined in terms of the Hensel expansion of x. We discuss the set of values taken by the exponents m and u at irrational p-adic numbers and compute the values of m and u at the Thue-Morse p-adic number.

talks.speaker: Maria Loukaki
talks.title: Chebotarev's theorem for groups of order $pq$ and an uncertainty principle
talks.abstract: Let $p$ be a prime number and $\zeta_p$ a primitive $p$-th root of unity. Chebotarev's theorem states that every square submatrix of the $p \times p$ matrix $(\zeta_p^{ij})_{i,j=0}^{p-1}$ is non-singular. In this talk we will show that a similar property holds for principal submatrices of $(\zeta_n^{ij})_{i,j=0}^{n-1}$, when $n=pr$ is the product of two distinct primes, and $p$ is a large enough prime that has order $r-1$ in $\mathbf{Z}_r^*$. As an application, an uncertainty principle for cyclic groups of order $n$ is established when $n=pr$ as described above.

talks.speaker: 周维祺
talks.title: On tiling sets and spectral sets in $Z_p^2\times Z_p^2$
talks.abstract: I will provide a new perspective on classifying tiling\spectral sets in Z_n\times Z_n using symplectic forms. The method is taken from a similar problem concerning Gabor systems, and applies to Fourier systems as well. It can then be shown that tiling sets and spectral sets coincide if n is the square of a prime number.

talks.speaker: 罗俊
talks.title: 广义若当区域上共形同胚的连续延拓问题
talks.location: 武大·理学院东北楼一楼报告厅（110)
talks.abstract: 介绍广义若当区域的定义与非平凡刻画，推广经典的Carathodory定理：在合理的前提条件下，得到广义若当区域D上共形同胚可以连续延拓到D的边界的“充分必要条件”。同时，给出具体的例子，说明前提条件的合理性。

talks.title: Maximal Gaps for Dilated Lacunary Integer Sequences
talks.speaker: 杨博寒
talks.affiliation: 上海数学与交叉学科研究院
talks.affiliationZh: 上海数学与交叉学科研究院
talks.abstract: Let $(a_n)$ be a lacunary sequence and let $G_N(x)$ denote the maximal gap of the finite orbit ${a_1x,\ldots,a_Nx}\subset\mathbb T$. The maximal gap is equivalent to the finite-time covering radius of the orbit and may be viewed as a deterministic analogue of the classical random covering problem. I will present almost-sure asymptotics for $G_N(x)$ with respect to Lebesgue measure. In particular, we show that $G_N(x)$ has the optimal order $(\log N)/N$. This is joint work with Yuval Peres.
talks.location: 武大·雷军科技楼349报告厅
